entries.text: StegVerse is governance infrastructure for consequential systems.
The ecosystem governs participation; it does not need to manufacture the intelligence.
Each governed component contributes a defined capability to the ecosystem.
Capability is not authority. Observation is not execution.
Governance preserves plural agency instead of collapsing decisions into one universal authority.
Ask not only what a system can do, but what it was permitted to do and what proves what happened.
Checkpoint: capability and authority remain separate.
